sleep-cycle-length.label: Sleep cycle length and count
sleep-cycle-length.value: about 90 min per cycle, about 4 to 6 cycles a night

elite-sleep-hours.label: Habitual sleep of elite athletes in training
elite-sleep-hours.value: about 6.8 h a night (individual sports 6.5 h, team sports 7.0 h)

sleep-loss-pooled.label: Pooled effect of sleep loss on exercise performance
sleep-loss-pooled.value: mean -7.56% (95% CI -11.9 to -3.13), 69 publications; consistent only after deprivation or late restriction; about 0.4% per hour awake

competition-night-sleep.label: Sleep on the night of competition versus earlier nights
competition-night-sleep.value: about 60 min shorter overall; 80 min after night competitions (start 18:00 or later), 20 min after day competitions
